pr_title: settings: Auto-update JSON schemas for settings when extensions are un/installed
pr_body:
Because of #26562, it is now possible to subscribe to extension update events within the LSP store, where we can then update the Schemas sent to the JSON LSP resulting in dynamic updates to the auto-complete suggestions and diagnostics in settings. Notably, this means newly installed languages and (icon) themes will auto-complete correctly as soon as the extension is installed.

Closes #15436

Release Notes:

- Fixed an issue where autocomplete suggestions and diagnostics for languages and (icon) themes in settings would not update when the extension with which they were added was installed or uninstalled

issue_context.title: Settings auto-complete for extension provided languages
issue_context.body:
### Description

1. Install an extension that provides a new language to Zed.
2. Open your settings and navigate to the `languages` block
3. Attempt to add a key inside languages for the new language.

Note there is no autocomplete. This would help people match the case and space correctly (`Git Ignore` not `gitignore`).

Originally reported by @fcolecumberri in #15342.

### Environment

Zed: v0.147.0 (Zed Nightly d6bdaa8a9141e181ec91ffb634cccae03e46ba08)
OS: macOS 14.5.0
Memory: 64 GiB
Architecture: aarch64
comments:
This is still an issue. You need to reload Zed before extension languages are available for autocomplete under `"languages" in settings.json.

I believe Zed just need to regenerate the Settings Schema after an extension installs to pickup the change in available language names.

This also impacts themes:
- https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/issues/14916

review_comments:
We use this event elsewhere to know when the set of extensions changed (but haven't necessarily fully reloaded), so I don't think we should change the location of where we emit it.

I think it would make sense to add a separate `ExtensionsReloaded` event if we care about knowing that they have been fully reloaded.
